title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 36
description: Ten questions on Genesis 36: the wives and descendants of Esau, the Horite chiefs and the kings of Edom.

questions.text: What other name is given to Esau in Genesis 36?
questions.explanation: This is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).

questions.text: Whose daughter was Adah, Esau's wife?
questions.explanation: Esau took Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite, from the daughters of Canaan.

questions.text: According to Genesis 36, whose daughter was Basemath?
questions.explanation: Basemath was Ishmael's daughter, the sister of Nebaioth.

questions.text: Which son did Adah bear to Esau?
questions.explanation: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz, and Basemath bore Reuel.

questions.text: Why did Esau move away from his brother Jacob?
questions.explanation: Their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land could not bear them because of their livestock.

answers.text: Jacob drove him out of the land of Canaan
Their possessions were too great to dwell together
There was a severe famine in Canaan
Isaac sent him away before he died

questions.text: Where did Esau live after leaving his brother?
questions.explanation: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.

answers.text: In the hill country of Seir
In the land of Paddan Aram

questions.text: Whom did Timna, Eliphaz's concubine, bear to him?
questions.explanation: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau's son, and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek.

questions.text: What did Anah find while feeding the donkeys of Zibeon his father?
questions.explanation: This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.

answers.text: A vein of gold in the hills
Wild honey in a hollow rock
The hot springs in the wilderness
Mandrakes in a field of wheat

questions.text: Who is the first king listed as reigning in Edom?
questions.explanation: Of the kings who reigned in Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel, the first named is Bela, the son of Beor, whose city was Dinhabah.

answers.text: Baal Hanan, the son of Achbor

questions.text: What is said of Hadad, the son of Bedad?
questions.explanation: Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in Husham's place. His city was Avith.

answers.text: He was the first king of Edom
He struck Midian in the field of Moab
He came from Rehoboth by the river
